assumptions.monthlyFold: previous month fit, current month forward, first 24h of forward month embargoed
assumptions.btcGate: BTC_RISK_ON only, using close/MA20/MA50 proxy shared with DEMO-SIM replay context
assumptions.costs: 4 bps fee plus 2 bps slippage per side
assumptions.comparisonCaveat: Existing DEMO-SIM replay comparison is limited to available paper-signal replay rows, currently August/September only.

rangeBreakoutBtcRiskOnComparison.note: Existing DEMO-SIM replay comparison is limited to available paper-signal replay rows, currently August/September only.

reasons: best sweep variant is not positive in at least 60% of forward months
best sweep variant max drawdown is above 25%
best sweep variant does not beat best touch-only baseline

limitations: Session sensitivity uses three simple offsets only: UTC, UTC+8, and UTC+12 style session boundaries.
Monthly folds are still candle-only and do not model book/trade flow, funding, liquidation context, queue position, or margin reservation.
Range-breakout comparison uses available historical DEMO-SIM replay rows, not a freshly derived candle-native range-breakout simulation.
The BTC gate remains a coarse research proxy, not a live watcher rule.
